notes: Fold the Done and Cut columns away. On a working board those two hold most of the cards - 131 of 205 on one of the tracked projects - and they are the two you look at least, so they were burying the columns you actually work from. Click a column's heading to fold it away; Done and Cut now start folded. The heading keeps its count, so nothing is concealed from you, and one click brings a column straight back. Importantly this is a fold and not a filter that removes the column: you can still drag a card into a folded Done, which is how most work gets marked finished, and when a card lands in a folded column its count flashes so the card never appears to just vanish. Your choices are remembered alongside the section arrangement from the last version, in your browser, so the board opens the way you left it. Folding only ever changes what you are looking at - it never moves, closes or alters a single card.
